description: Karnataka links marine growth with AI-ready data centre expansion
body_lead: Landmark Group plans Rs 150 billion NCR expansion Landmark Group has announced expansion plans across two real estate projects in the National Capital Region (NCR), with a combined estimated sales potential of Rs 150 billion. The projects include Landmark One, a 2.1 million sq ft corporate office development on Golf Course Extension Road in Gurugram, and a proposed integrated hospitality, commercial and residential development on Dwarka Expressway.Landmark One has an estimated sales value of Rs 40 billion.
